subject.title: refactor: canonicalize correctness-critical UI and channel contracts

question: Which canonical owner and sequencing should be approved for the channel status, Control UI protocol, and Workboard contracts before implementation starts?
rationale: The requested cleanup is desirable but security- and compatibility-sensitive: it changes credential-redaction DTOs, protocol frame consumption, and plugin-to-UI contract ownership across multiple teams.

options.title: Approve the split sequence
options.body: Proceed with separate channel-status, Workboard-contract, and then Control UI gateway-frame PRs, each with focused tests and no broad compatibility aliases unless a shipped contract is cited.

options.title: Narrow to channel status first
options.body: Start only with the credential-sensitive channel status DTO and revisit Workboard and gateway-frame canonicalization after that boundary lands.

options.title: Defer the umbrella
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not queue implementation until maintainers decide the permanent Control UI and plugin contract ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the split sequence
recommendation.body: Proceed with separate channel-status, Workboard-contract, and then Control UI gateway-frame PRs, each with focused tests and no broad compatibility aliases unless a shipped contract is cited.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to this maintainer-labeled staged cleanup and are best positioned to confirm the intended sequencing.
